title: Chapter 272 Desert Lizardman
content:
Chapter 272 Desert Lizardman

This ancient desert territory is very mysterious and special. Its lord's protection covers the entire desert. The desert races living here have not been affected by strange things at all.

The desert lizard people's territory has been invaded by outsiders, and the intruders are heretics without faith. Of course, the two sides have nothing to say, and it will be over if they start fighting.

There are only a few good races that can survive in this world, and the weak ones have long been eliminated.

The desert lizardmen in the area around the main city of the Naga desert battlefield are all gathering in this direction, preparing to capture the newly built desert city of the Naga tribe in one fell swoop.

This is exactly what the Nagas want to see.

When opening a new battlefield, unless it is a very familiar area, you will definitely have to stick to the city and wait for the enemy to attack.

Only after a large number of effective enemy forces in the surrounding areas have been eliminated can we launch large-scale reconnaissance activities, and then decide whether to take the initiative based on the actual situation in the surrounding area.

People like the Nagas who go to high-risk areas alone to open new battlefields will be defensive operations for a long time to come.

This is like if a city from the evil god camp suddenly appeared in the Zerg territory, then Wu Qing would definitely concentrate all his efforts to destroy it.

No matter how high the price is, you cannot let the enemy drive a nail into your heartland.

If the Naga tribe can hold on to the main city as they wish and persist for a long time until the attacking enemy is exhausted, this passive defensive posture will be possible to change.

Outside the main desert city of the Naga tribe, there are not many desert lizardmen who can gather in a short period of time. They are simply vulnerable to the tens of millions of Naga tribe troops relying on city defense.

But those desert lizardmen who gathered first bravely launched an attack on the main desert city of the Naga tribe.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Some of the Zerg Vandals opened fire.

All areas around the main city of the Naga desert are covered by the firepower of the Zerg destroyers.

The Zerg Destroyer ammunition is used as a super long-range attack unit that can automatically recover. It is very cost-effective to use, so against a small number of enemies, the Zerg Destroyer is also used to attack.

This saves money without any risk of attrition.

It is precisely because there are more than 500,000 Zerg Destroyers that can be upgraded at any time that the Naga tribe is confident to open up this desert battlefield. With the Zerg Destroyers, the most difficult initial defense stage of opening the battlefield becomes simple. a lot of.

For this purpose, the Naga tribe also prepared a large number of luck beads and energy coins.

Wu Qing was of course happy to do this. As long as he could kill the enemy, the Zerg were willing to do it.

The first to fire were the one-star Zerg Destroyers, who wanted to test the killing effect of the Zerg Destroyer's attack on the desert race.

The desert lizard man, whose whole body is covered in thick scales, also uses his natural sand magic to cover his body with a layer of sand to enhance his defense.

The liquid fireball of the one-star Zerg Destroyer exploded, knocking down swarms of desert lizardmen.

Most of these desert lizardmen have ordinary strength and have not yet reached the stars, but their defense capabilities are good. Under the attack of the one-star Zerg Destroyer, the casualties are less than the star-level troops of the Skeleton Clan. .

This proves that the attack of the Zerg Destroyer has no power bonus to the desert race.

This test result is within the expected range of the Zerg and Naga. It is not easy to encounter a situation like the Skeleton Tribe being restrained by the attack of the Zerg Destroyer.

The defense of the desert lizardmen is stronger than that of ordinary soldiers, but compared with the army of the Outer Worlds, it is still far behind.

Most of the desert lizardmen who came to attack now were ordinary soldiers. The Zerg saboteurs only opened fire a few times and almost wiped out all the desert lizardmen.

This was also a probing attack by the Desert Lizardmen, which led to attacks from ultra-long-range attack units such as the Zerg Destroyers, and they stopped attacking.

The results of the desert lizard people's probing attacks were fed back. Wu Qing observed through the Zerg host that the strength of the desert lizard people gathered behind was getting stronger and stronger, and various types of soldiers also appeared one after another.

To be able to mobilize such a powerful army in such a short period of time, the strength of the Desert Lizard Clan cannot be underestimated.

At night, wind and sand suddenly arose on the calm desert. The fluctuating magical energy allowed the Zerg host to lock onto the desert lizard man mage who was casting spells in the desert lizard army.

They are a bit far away from the main city of the Naga desert. The Zerg destroyers in the center of the main city cannot reach such a far range. They can only watch helplessly as those desert lizard wizards create a magic The desert storm gradually enveloped the Naga desert main city and surrounding areas.

A desert storm of this scope has almost no lethality, but it can change the combat environment and affect the sight and combat effectiveness of the Naga army.

For the desert lizard people, this kind of desert storm is their most adaptable home field.

"No. 3, does this sandstorm have any impact on you?"

"If there is any impact, I will let our mage take action to eliminate it!"

Nagaya asked Host No. 3.

This kind of wind and sand affects the vision the most. Ordinary people are trapped in it and cannot distinguish between east, west and north, and cannot see anything in front of them.

The Naga tribe has a way to deal with this situation. Naga asked Host No. 3 first. She knows the terrible detection and perception ability of the Zerg. She may not need to waste the means of the Naga mage, the Zerg itself can deal with it. .

More than 500,000 Zerg destroyers are the main attack force in defensive operations. Enemies that can break through the Zerg destroyer's firepower network need the Naga army to take action to eliminate them.

"This kind of wind and sand has no effect on us!"

"You are responsible for defending the city wall, and leave the rest to us!"

Host No. 3 said confidently.

More than 500,000 Zerg destroyers, including 9,000 five-star Zerg destroyers, are a powerful firepower output force.

When necessary, the Naga tribe will also provide luck beads and energy coins for Zerg destroyers to use.

Wu Qing is looking forward to the ultimate strength of this Zerg destroyer hired by the Naga tribe.

The desert lizardmen outside the Naga desert main city launched a general attack on the desert main city under the cover of artificial sandstorms.

Wu Qing couldn't tell whether the hundreds of thousands of desert lizardmen who gathered in a very short time were troops or ordinary people, and they all looked very fierce.

Hundreds of thousands of desert lizardmen rushed into the attack range of the Zerg destroyers.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Except for the five-star Zerg destroyers, all other star-level Zerg destroyers opened fire.

The fierce firepower accurately hit the charging desert lizardmen, covering all the hundreds of thousands of desert lizardmen.

With the Zerg host, artificial sandstorms are just a small trick, and they are useless to the Zerg.

The terrible firepower coverage of the Zerg destroyers stunned hundreds of thousands of desert lizardmen in one round of attack.

A large number of desert lizardmen disappeared in light, and the survivors suffered varying degrees of injuries.

The desert lizardmen had too few troops, and compared with the troops of the Zerg destroyers, they were not much more. The desert lizardmen were almost one-on-one, and they gathered together to bear the overlapping damage of the Zerg destroyers, so the damage they suffered was very terrible.

Some Zerg destroyers continued to fire at the positions where there were more desert lizardmen, killing all the attacking troops of the desert lizardmen.

The sound of the Zerg destroyer's artillery broke the peace of this desert area, and a huge camp war began!

The sandstorm in the desert was getting bigger and bigger, and the desert race seemed to be able to use the wind and sand to gather more and more troops.

Moreover, in addition to the desert lizards, some other strange desert races also appeared.

Relying on the intelligence provided by the Zerg host, the Zerg destroyer opened fire from time to time under the cover of the sandstorm, accurately attacking enemies who dared to enter their attack range.

The Naga tribe also noticed that more and more enemies were gathering around the desert main city. In order to prevent the emergence of abnormalities, the Naga mages took action to clear the wind and sand near the walls of the desert main city.

As long as there were enemies breaking through the Zerg destroyer's firepower network, they would be solved by the Naga army stationed on the wall.

Seeing that the Naga tribe had already taken action, Wu Qing no longer wasted the firepower of the Zerg destroyer to attack those who slipped through the net. A small number of desert lizardmen rushed to the attack range of the Naga army and were killed by the Naga army.

The Zerg destroyers will try to preserve their firepower and prepare for a protracted war with various desert races that are attacking.

The desert races have gathered enough troops nearby, and under the leadership of the desert lizardmen, they once again launched an attack on the Naga desert main city.

No matter what special abilities the numerous desert races have, the Zerg destroyers will use powerful firepower to make them disappear before they can exert their abilities.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Faced with an attack of this scale, the Zerg destroyers finally opened up their firepower.

The attack power of nine thousand five-star Zerg destroyers is very terrible. With one shot, a large area of desert lizardmen disappeared.

More than half a million Zerg destroyers are like the main city of the Naga desert. With them, millions of enemies can't rush in at all!

Wu Qing fought against the alien race, and the number of Zerg destroyers was only 50,000. It was not until the end of the two battles with the alien race that Wu Qing increased the number of Zerg destroyers to 150,000.

It is conceivable that the Naga tribe, which is so extravagant, can use such a large number of Zerg destroyers together, what kind of effect can be produced.

The Naga tribe was afraid that the firepower of 9,000 five-star Zerg destroyers was not strong enough, and they also prepared a large number of luck beads and energy coins for the Zerg destroyers, so that the Zerg destroyers can be upgraded at any time.

From the current situation, the initial defense of the Naga desert main city is no problem at all, and the Zerg destroyers can take it alone.

The subsequent defense depends on whether the desert races of the evil god camp in this area can find a siege force with sufficient strength.
